question: The original name of Mahabharata is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaya Samhita**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Jaya Samhita is the original name of Mahabharata.__
 
• Mahabharata was written down by Lord Ganesha.
 
• Mahabharata was narrated by Maharishi Ved Vyasa.
 
• Mahabharata narrates the struggle between Kaurava and the Panḍava princes and their successors.
 
• Mahabharata is known as "the longest poem ever written"
 
• Mahabharata was translated in the Persian which was titled "Razmnama", was produced at Akbar's orders, by Faizi and ʽAbd al-Qadir Badayuni.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Bhrigu Samhita:

 
 
• This is an ancient astrological text attributed to the sage Bhrigu.
 
• It is believed to contain the records of the planetary positions and influences on individuals' lives based on their birth charts.
 
• The Bhrigu Samhita is highly regarded in Vedic astrology for its predictions and astrological insights, especially in relation to karma and destiny.
 
 
 
• Shiva Samhita:
 
 
• The Shiva Samhita is a classical text on yoga and spiritual practice.
 
• It is attributed to Lord Shiva and is considered one of the major texts in Hatha Yoga.
 
• It contains detailed instructions on yogic practices, meditation, and the paths to spiritual enlightenment, focusing on the physical and mental benefits of yoga.
 
• The text is popular among practitioners of traditional Hatha Yoga.
 
 
 
• Sushruta Samhita:
 
 
• The Sushruta Samhita is one of the foundational texts of Ayurveda (the ancient system of medicine from India).
 
• Attributed to the sage Sushruta, it is particularly focused on surgery and surgical techniques.
 
• The text is known for its detailed descriptions of surgical instruments, procedures, and anatomy, making it one of the earliest works on surgery in the world.
